scripts.synth: npm run build && npx cdk synth
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx cdk deploy IssueMgmtJiraSecretsStack IssueMgmtDataStack IssueMgmtCoreStack IssueMgmtObservabilityStack
scripts.destroy: npx cdk destroy IssueMgmtObservabilityStack IssueMgmtCoreStack IssueMgmtDataStack IssueMgmtJiraSecretsStack
scripts.smoke:assign: curl -s -X POST "$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name IssueMgmtCoreStack --query 'Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey==`ApiUrl`].OutputValue' --output text)mcp/assign" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"tool":"assign.compute_recommendation","params":{"description":"Payment processing bug in checkout flow","component":"payments","labels":["urgent","backend"]}}' | jq .
